what: The camera: the person presses the shutter for every still and the app judges each one, out loud, with stage bubbles, a point cloud where it finds things, the found pop-up and fact chips. spec/pages.md §6.5, spec/features/capture.md, spec/ways-out.md §6.4 and §6.5.

frame.who: Clearing out, with a pile, often on poor signal; Holding a minimum, with one good thing; Testing the water, in Worth mode. Once per item, tens of stills a day.
frame.came_to: Get the thing in without thinking: one instruction at a time, press, see what it read, next.
frame.costly_mistake: A wrong fact going into the listing unseen: every fact is a chip the person can see and a blank they can fill; a duplicate asks Same thing? before making a second item.
frame.ways_out: Choose photos from the library; skip a step; switch Sell, Worth and Find without losing the stills; camera access denied offers Settings and the library; no signal keeps shooting and waits.
frame.in_the_loop: The person takes every still; the app says what it read and shows what it has not; the draft waits for their review.

decisions: The camera sits between two solid bars, ink black in light and the dark page in dark, as the phone's own camera; the feed shows between them, and nothing light covers the screen at night.
Words sit on the bars, never on the feed (Art. 5.1); a fact over the feed is a chip on the surface color with ink words.
One pop per still, its most identifying fact; the other facts fill their chips quietly, so the pop is never a queue.
The pop holds 1.5 s: Art. 11's on-screen hold for one or two words is at least 1.5 s.
The check is ink, not mint: mint means sold everywhere else (Art. 5.3).
The point cloud gathers in clusters where features were found and leaves when the still is judged; nothing loops or repeats.
Sell, Worth and Find sit as words above the shutter, like the phone camera's modes, so a wrong choice on New costs one tap and no stills.
Paste a link and Describe it live on New; the library button lives here, left of the shutter, as on the phone's camera.
A still that matches something already held asks Same thing? with that item, and the agent's guess (same) is the black pill.
A brand or model typed into its blank is matched to the catalog with spelling tolerance before the chip shows it: Carhart reads Carhartt (edge-cases §3).
When two things look alike, the camera offers both and I don’t know as three answers of one weight; I don’t know lists it from what can be seen (edge-cases §4).

A maker’s mark, hallmark or signature stops the quick path: a sheet says why and offers Appraise first as the black pill, with Price it anyway beside it; until then nothing is sold fast or marked down (edge-cases §4).

Clean up and Enhance with AI are two chips side by side once the stills are done, Clean up first, both off until picked; one only adjusts the photo, the other redraws it and says so in its name (edge-cases §6).
